breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.

There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in torsion formulas. This matches the ground truth prompt, which properly applies the polar moment of inertia J throughout.
